headline: BII Targets $3 Billion Investment in Africa's Higher-Risk Markets
summary: British International Investment plans to invest about $3 billion (£2.25 billion) in Africa's higher-risk markets over five years.
why: British International Investment is the UK government's development-finance institution, deploying capital to stimulate economic growth and private sector development in developing regions.

impacts.name: Development Finance
impacts.why: Targeted institutional capital injection aims to boost infrastructure and enterprise growth in developing African markets.
